template.venue_quote_note: For this exact 3 NEAR order on {venue}, the signed executable protection floor is {floor} USDC total after depth, oracle confidence, and routing impact. Use this total as min_out; it is the conservative anti-revert guardrail, not a change to the displayed midpoint.

values: Midpoint remains useful for display, but the executable floor is the value intended for slippage protection.
Slippage protection should track the executable floor so the swap can clear during normal pool movement.
Use the floor value as the minimum acceptable USDC for the whole order when forming the swap call.
The quoted floor already includes the safety haircut that prevents benign market movement from causing a failed swap.
